text: Native return storage shall be separate from ordinary locals, preflight every implicit/explicit push or link-save frame, and reserve the manifest emergency portion exclusively for terminal reporting. Predecrement SP shall begin at aligned region end; postdecrement SP at last usable byte/index, respecting actual return writes.
